prompt:
Scene:
A square color magazine advertisement illustration, medium close-up on the cadmium-red built-in push-button wall oven from the reference kitchen. Camera slightly angled from the right side, eye-level, same warm studio lighting as the reference. Halftone print grain and slight CMYK offset match the reference.

Subject:
The same red push-button wall oven established in the reference shot, now shown in detail: five amber glowing buttons labeled with tiny icons of sunbursts and clock faces, a chrome analog timer dial, a porthole window showing a golden-brown roast chicken on a turquoise platter inside, and a small chrome nameplate on the top edge. A woman's slender hand with red nail polish and a thin gold wedding band is just touching the third button. Edge of the ivory laminate counter and a sliver of boomerang-pattern wallpaper remain visible at frame edges to tie the shot to the kitchen.

Important details:
Preserve the exact oven form, button layout, chrome trim, and red enamel shade from the reference image. The boomerang wallpaper pattern peeking at the edge must match in motif and color. Keep halftone grain and offset printing feel. The hand must be a stylized mid-century illustration hand, not photorealistic. The amber button glow is a warm incandescent orange, not LED blue.

Use case:
Turquoise Kitchen Set series shot 2 of 4, a detail moment that must live inside the same room established by the reference.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no modern LCD display, no touchscreen, no photoreal skin, no depth-of-field blur, no modern flat minimalist design, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, preserve the reference oven and wallpaper.
